rows.basis: Ciena ties FY2025 demand to AI only in words: 'unprecedented increases in demand, in particular as a result of expenditures related to AI and other cloud-based applications' (MD&A), RLS records 'driven by hyperscaler AI infrastructure buildouts' and WL6e ramps 'driven by AI network buildouts'. The stated 'Direct Cloud Provider revenue ... 40% of total revenue' (Q3 FY2025) is a customer group, not an AI line, so it is not used as a stated share. Networking Platforms segment revenue (3,676,377,000) is the seller-side signal but is not a data-center or AI line.

The MD&A says that, to capture opportunities created by the impact of AI on networks, Ciena continued to develop its WaveLogic coherent modem technology, including for use inside and around the data center. No amount or share of operating expense is attributed to AI.

The MD&A says that in fiscal 2024 Ciena continued to develop WaveLogic coherent modem technology to capture market opportunities created by the impact of AI on networks. No amount or share of operating expense is attributed to AI.
